target_customer: Employers with high volume hourly and gig hiring, such as logistics, retail and food companies
problem: Hiring, screening and onboarding large numbers of hourly workers is slow and manual.
product_category: HR tech, frontline hiring and onboarding platform

founders.name: Keith Ryu
founders.background_notes: YC page and TechCrunch 2019 name him. Replaced as CEO by Sean Behr in September 2020 and stayed on for strategic initiatives. No education or employers found.

founders.name: Jeremy Cai
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch March 2015 calls him co-founder of OnboardIQ, Fountain's earlier name; not on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Workflow software integrating background checks, signatures and messaging, with standard engineering and many third party integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations into HR systems create some lock in, but hiring workflow tools were easy to copy early on.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: TechCrunch 2015 said OnboardIQ worked alongside Checkr and HelloSign rather than replacing them; later the company grew independently.

market_need_then: TechCrunch in March 2015 said early on demand startups Eaze and SpoonRocket already used OnboardIQ to simplify onboarding workers.

branding.domain_note: fountain.com is the exact domain; the footer still lists Fountain (Onboard IQ).

identity.mascot_or_character: AI agents named Cue, Anna, Emma and Sam on the 2026 site

rebrands.why: Reason not found; year not confirmed

brand_strength.rationale: Rename to a simple real word suits a growing enterprise brand, but no source shows brand pull beyond sales.

pivots.to: Hiring and onboarding software for on demand companies (OnboardIQ, later Fountain)
pivots.why: Per one profile; no reason stated

outcome_analysis: Fountain started as OnboardIQ serving gig startups, renamed and grew into a frontline hiring platform that raised 23 million in 2019 and 185 million across Series C and extension in 2021 and 2022. Gig and hourly hiring demand helped, and the founder handed the CEO role to Sean Behr in 2020.
notes: TechCrunch 2019 says total funding reached 34M with this round, so about 11M earlier (including a 2017 round at a 40M valuation) is not identified. Series B date conflicts: TechCrunch URL dated Oct 29 2019 while Fountain press archive lists April 30 2019. Founded year taken from the YC page; OnboardIQ launched in private beta March 2015. Rename year unknown. The pivot comes from a single profile. Checkr and HelloSign are complements not rivals so competitor list left empty.
